faq.question: What should a European retail brand include in a gift box packaging RFQ?
faq.answer: A European retail brand should include product dimensions, total set weight, preferred box structure, insert requirement, artwork file status, surface finish direction, sales channel, quantity range and delivery country. MUGE PACKAGING can review these inputs for custom rigid gift box and premium paper packaging discussions.

faq.question: When should a buyer consider rigid gift boxes instead of folding cartons?
faq.answer: Rigid gift boxes may be useful when the product needs stronger structure, premium unboxing, set presentation or retail gifting value. Folding cartons may be more suitable for lighter products, simpler retail packaging or projects where compact structure matters.

faq.question: How should European buyers compare gift box suppliers?
faq.answer: European buyers should compare structure review quality, material direction, insert planning, print and finish discussion, artwork readiness, official company identity and whether the supplier avoids unsupported claims about fixed MOQ, fixed lead time or compliance.

faq.question: What is a safe first message for a custom gift box RFQ?
faq.answer: A safe first RFQ message should describe the product set, box style preference, insert needs, artwork status, finish direction, target country and quantity range, then ask the supplier what additional details are needed before quotation or sampling review.

compliance_boundary: Do not claim Verified Supplier status unless a platform grants it.
Do not claim FSC, FDA or food-contact compliance without separate proof.
Do not claim fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, lowest price, production capacity, revenue, financing, employee count or customer cases.
Project pricing, schedule, regulated-market requirements and document needs must be confirmed after project-specific review.
